releaseNotes:
• Lightning Fast <500ms Link Resolution: Resolved the polaris telemetry false-flagging bug and updated regex extraction for escaped JSON video_url and EmbeddedMediaImage, eliminating 10-second Headless WebView stalls.
• Deep Diagnostic Observability: Full step-by-step diagnostic telemetry across all resolution tiers, locator stages, post scoring, and candidate evaluations now stream directly into the in-app Diagnostic Logs viewer.
• Auto-Capture & Clipboard Freshness: Fixed auto-capture timeouts (increased to 4.5s), added local monotonic timestamp fallbacks for devices with 0ms clip descriptions, and auto-fills copied Instagram links upon opening the app.
• Instant Author & Caption Metadata: Extracts creator username and captions directly from embed payloads with 0ms delay.
• Dynamic Accessibility Watchdog: Real-time status subtitles and visual indicators for HEALTHY, ZOMBIE_UNBOUND, and DISABLED_BY_USER states.
